facts.text: The Cloister is set on 50 acres surrounded by the river, saltwater marshes and the sea.
facts.excerpt: The Cloister is set on 50 lush acres, surrounded by the river, saltwater marshes, and the sea, with five miles of private coastline across the street.

facts.text: The Sea Island Beach Club and a five-mile stretch of private beach are right across the street from The Cloister Main Building.
facts.excerpt: The Sea Island Beach Club and our gorgeous five-mile stretch of private beach are right across the street.

facts.text: Beach Club rooms at The Cloister have Spanish Mediterranean decor with Oriental rugs and exposed beam ceilings, and many have ocean views.
facts.excerpt: Signature Spanish Mediterranean décor, including Oriental rugs, exposed beam ceilings, many rooms with expansive ocean views.

facts.text: The Sea Island Beach Club has three swimming pools and water sports.
facts.excerpt: At the Beach Club, you’re steps away from our five miles of private beach, three swimming pools, and many water sports and activities.

facts.text: The Cloister Ocean Residences sit in a private, gated enclave with their own oceanfront infinity pool.
facts.excerpt: Ocean Residences give you the ultimate seclusion in a private, gated enclave with its own oceanfront infinity pool.

facts.text: Rooms in The Cloister's Garden Wing are reached along outdoor corridors past koi ponds and gardens.
facts.excerpt: Meander outdoor corridors, past koi ponds, through lush, captivating gardens, and manicured grounds to a light and airy room to call your own.

facts.text: The Spa at Sea Island is inspired by water, with hydrotherapy, foot reflexology paths and mineral soaking tubs.
facts.excerpt: Hydrotherapy, foot reflexology paths, and mineral soaking tubs.

facts.text: The Fitness Center has an indoor heated lap pool, squash courts, steam and sauna, whirlpool and cryotherapy.
facts.excerpt: Also features indoor heated lap pool, squash courts, steam and sauna, whirlpool, and cryotherapy.

facts.text: The Lodge offers 24-hour personal butler service.
facts.excerpt: With 24-hour personal butler service, even a luxurious rose-petal bath, drawn just to your liking.

facts.text: The Lodge sits right next door to championship golf.
facts.excerpt: The Lodge is welcoming, comfortable, and the hub of its own Sea Island world, with championship golf right next door.

facts.text: Sea Island has three championship golf courses and a 17,000-square-foot Golf Performance Center.
facts.excerpt: Here that means three championship golf courses, top instructors, teeing areas and practice greens, and a 17,000-square-foot, state-of-the-art Golf Performance Center.

facts.text: The Plantation and Seaside courses are home to the PGA TOUR's RSM Classic.
facts.excerpt: Along with the neighboring Seaside Course, it is the home of the PGA TOUR’s RSM Classic, a FedEx cup event hosted by Davis Love.

facts.text: The Seaside Course is a Scottish links-style course surrounded by tidal creeks, dunes, salt marshes and the Atlantic Ocean.
facts.excerpt: A legendary Scottish links style, surrounded by tidal creeks, dunes, salt marshes, and the Atlantic Ocean.

facts.text: The Lodge's 18-hole Speedway Putting Course was designed by Mark Love and Davis Love III.
facts.excerpt: The Lodge’s 18-hole putting course, designed by Mark Love and Davis Love III.

facts.text: Guests can take horseback rides along the south end of Sea Island beach.
facts.excerpt: Horseback rides along the south end of Sea Island beach are a unique way to explore the ocean beach habitat of the Georgia coast.

facts.text: The Hawk Walk is a 90-minute experience with Sea Island's trained raptors.
facts.excerpt: Experience the Hawk Walk, a 90-minute adventure that brings you up close with Sea Island’s trained raptors.

facts.text: A walking tour of The Cloister covers its history along with art, architecture and antiquities unique to the hotel.
facts.excerpt: Hear the major events that shaped our past and present, along with experiencing an immersive adventure of art, architecture, and antiquities unique to The Cloister.

facts.text: Guests can count sea turtle nests and go paddleboarding.
facts.excerpt: Count sea turtle nests, go paddleboarding, or enjoy the thrill of having a Harris hawk swoop down and perch on your outstretched arm.

facts.text: Guests can take out a complimentary BMW during their stay, first come, first served, for up to two hours.
facts.excerpt: Cars are available on a first-come, first-served basis for up to two hours of driving.

facts.text: Southern Tide at the Beach Club is an al fresco oceanfront restaurant.
facts.excerpt: At once formal and casual, this al fresco oceanfront restaurant is a beloved favorite for good reason.

facts.text: Wonderland at the Beach Club serves the Sea Island signature Gold Brick Sundae.
facts.excerpt: And, of course, the Sea Island signature Gold Brick Sundae.

facts.text: Broadfield is Sea Island's 5,800-acre sporting club and lodge.
facts.excerpt: This is Broadfield, Sea Island’s 5,800-acre Sporting Club and Lodge.

facts.text: Broadfield is off the main Sea Island property, less than an hour's drive south near Woodbine.
facts.excerpt: Located off of the main Sea Island property less than an hour drive south near Woodbine is Broadfield, A Sea Island Sporting Club and Lodge.

facts.text: The Lodge is a few minutes' drive from Sea Island and The Cloister.
facts.excerpt: The Lodge is a world unto its own just a few minutes’ drive from Sea Island and The Cloister.

facts.text: Golf events held at Sea Island throughout the year limit play on the courses.
facts.excerpt: While these are always great to attend, they do limit play.

facts.text: The Spa at Sea Island is a Forbes Five-Star spa.
facts.excerpt: Our Forbes Five-Star spa features a water-inspired wellness journey complete with a variety of massage services, body treatments, and experiences including hydrotherapy, cold plunges, and hot pools.

facts.text: The Lodge is a Forbes Five-Star boutique hotel.
facts.excerpt: A Forbes Five-Star boutique hotel in a secluded, private setting, The Lodge is welcoming, comfortable, and the hub of its own Sea Island world
